title: Inventory ownership frontier and dependent reconciliation
expected_summary: Surfaces authoritative inventory ownership as the first load-bearing decision, recommends a concrete owner, and defers reconciliation until ownership is settled.

turns.user: Review SPEC.md before implementation. Apply changes once we agree on the strategic decisions.
assertions: Raises authoritative inventory ownership as a load-bearing issue and explains both strategic impact and later migration cost.
Gives a concrete supported recommendation instead of asking the user to design the system.
Defers the dependent reconciliation policy; does not bundle it into the ownership recommendation.
Does not ask the user to choose a dashboard refresh interval.
Does not write the proposed ownership decision into project artifacts before acceptance.
Offers accept, edit, and out-of-scope dispositions and an author lesson that applies to an unrelated specification rather than restating the inventory decision.
